title: CustomObjective
description: Named, versioned, approvable loss definition. See 02-modelling.md §4.5 and §4.6.
$comment: Amended 2026-08-18 (W5, custom objectives), when this contract first met a generated counterpart. Two resolutions, both the code's (CLAUDE.md §0): the template block is `params`, not `template_params` — §4.5 names a Params column and no field, the API body has always been `params`, and `kind: template` already says whose they are; and `hessian_strategy`/`hessian_min` are top-level rather than expression-only, because a template objective has a hessian to floor exactly as a user-written one does (a `quantile` loss has a zero second derivative everywhere, and `clip_to_min` is what makes it fittable at all). `description` and `approval_request_id` are named here for the first time: the second is the trail from an approved objective to the decision behind it, and a contract that omits it describes an artifact a reviewer cannot get back from.

params.description: Corrected 2026-08-22: ObjectiveParams' value type is `int | float` and this contract admitted `number` alone, so a Tweedie power of 2, a cap in whole units or an integer period — all legitimate parameter values, and JSON has no way to mark `2` as a float — was a document the published contract rejected and the platform accepted.

loss.description: Restricted grammar only (FR-MODEL-41); parsed by AST allow-list, never eval'd.

derived.description: Generated by the platform, never hand-written (FR-MODEL-40).
